description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Accepted" name="Offer accepted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusCompleted" name="Company status updates completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter / Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="SendTask_Offer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Accept" name="Offer accepted" sourceRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusCompleted" name="Company status updates completed" sourceRef="IntermediateThrow_StatusCompleted" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CompanyStatusDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet" sourceRef="SendTask_Tweet" targetRef="Participant_Twitter"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student Internship Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Start internship search"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterProfile" name="Enter topic, desired salary, experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOffers" name="Wait for offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_OfferReceived" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_OfferReceived" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DecideOffer" name="Accept or deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Offer accepted?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_AcceptOffer" name="Send acceptance to company" messageRef="Message_Accepted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusFork" name="Start status updates"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentStatusMerge" name="Write status updates"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_WriteStatus" name="Write status update about internship"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentCount" name="3 status updates written?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_CompanyStatusDone" name="Company status updates completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_CompanyStatusDone" messageRef="Message_StatusCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusJoin" name="Internship finished"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendChoice" name="Recommend company to friends?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Tweet" name="Recommend company to friends via Twitter">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics id="MultiInstance_Tweets" isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Recommended" name="Recommendation sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRecommended" name="No recommendation"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="UserTask_EnterProfile"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterProfile" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOffers" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S4" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_OfferReceived" targetRef="UserTask_DecideOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S5" sourceRef="UserTask_DecideOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S6" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S7" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S8" sourceRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S9" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_StatusFork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusFork" targetRef="Gateway_StudentStatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusFork" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CompanyStatusDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatusMerge" targetRef="UserTask_WriteStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="UserTask_WriteStatus" targetRef="Gateway_StudentCount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S14" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCount" targetRef="Gateway_StudentStatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S15" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCount" targetRef="Gateway_StatusJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S16" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_CompanyStatusDone" targetRef="Gateway_StatusJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S17" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusJoin" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S18" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendChoice" targetRef="SendTask_Tweet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S19" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendChoice" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRecommended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S20" sourceRef="SendTask_Tweet" targetRef="EndEvent_Recommended"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OfferReady" name="Offer prepared"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Offer" name="Send offer to student" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Accepted" messageRef="Message_Accepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyStatusMerge" name="Write status updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatus" name="Write status update about student"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyCount" name="3 status updates written?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="IntermediateThrow_StatusCompleted" name="Status updates completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_StatusCompleted" messageRef="Message_StatusCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusDone" name="Company process finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OfferReady" targetRef="SendTask_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="SendTask_Offer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyStatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyStatusMerge" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatus" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyCount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyCount" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyStatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyCount" targetRef="IntermediateThrow_StatusCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="IntermediateThrow_StatusCompleted" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
